replyStyle.short: - Keep replies short: answer first, under about 150 words, details only when needed.
replyStyle.detailed: - Give detailed replies: explain what was done and why, with the evidence, in full sentences.

autonomy.outward: - Ask before outward-facing or irreversible actions (pushes, pull requests, releases, deletes, anything that touches a live system); go ahead with local, reversible work.
autonomy.ask-all: - Ask before making any change: say what you plan to do and wait for a yes before delegating or editing anything.
autonomy.rare: - Ask rarely: decide from context and defaults, and ask only when the answer would be hard to undo or the request cannot be understood.

prs.me: - The user opens pull requests. Workers push a named branch and stop; you report the branch.
prs.workers-draft: - Workers open draft pull requests for their branch. Never mark one ready for review and never merge.

language.same: - Reply in the language the user writes in.

guardrails.neverTouch: - Never touch: {{text}}. If a task needs it, stop and ask the user.
guardrails.secretsDir: - Secrets live in `{{path}}`. Agents may use them, never read them: load a file inside the command that needs it, never open, print or copy its contents.

docs:
- Docs folder: `{{docsDir}}` (outside every project repo). Its `README.md` has the index and the rules; each project has a subfolder `{{docsDir}}/<project>/` with START-HERE, SPEC, DECISIONS, LOG and INBOX.
- Read a project's `START-HERE.md` and the newest `LOG.md` entry before you scope or delegate for it. Every worker brief points to the same files and asks the worker to update them in the same session.
